    Contact Notion for press & media inquiries

    In this help doc

    Learn how to get in touch with Notion if you're a member of the media.

    If you’re a journalist or member of the media, email us at [email protected].

    This inbox is for press and media inquiries, including requests for comments, interviews, company info, or media resources. This is the fastest way to get a response. If you’re working on a deadline, let us know and we’ll follow up as soon as possible.
